explanation:
$\begin{aligned} & \frac{E_2}{E_1}=\frac{K T_2}{K T_1}=\frac{T_2}{T_1}=\frac{500 \mathrm{~K}}{300 \mathrm{~K}}=\frac{5}{3} \\ & \therefore E_2=\frac{5}{3} \times E_1=1.6667 E_1 \\ & \quad=E_1+6667 E_1=E_1+\frac{6667}{100} E_1=E_1+66.67 \% E_1\end{aligned}$ 
অর্থাৎ, গতিশক্তি বৃদ্ধি পায় 66.67%।

explanation:
আমরা জানি, $\mathrm{PV}=\frac{1}{3} \mathrm{mNC}^2=\frac{3}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} \mathrm{MC}^2$ বা, $\mathrm{PV}=\frac{2}{3} \times \mathrm{E}$ বা, $\mathrm{P}=\frac{2}{3} \times \frac{\mathrm{E}}{\mathrm{V}}$ $\therefore P=\frac{2}{3} E_1\left[\because E_1=\frac{E}{V}\right]$
